svg.aria-label: Dog off-leash areas in Vancouver parks, from City open data
svg.text: 54 mapped off-leash polygons in 42 parks, 65.0 ha in this dataset (red; rings scale with area). Green: City parks.
The Park Board counts 36 off-leash areas, about 68 ha (item 09); dataset records are counted differently.
Source: City of Vancouver open data, "Dog off-leash parks" and "Parks polygon representation", "Shoreline 2002" (accessed Oct 17, 2026).
